annotations.title: ToolFit: Audit an agent tool list

description:
Check the tool definitions an agent loads, before they cost tokens or fail: estimated tokens per tool, schema errors per provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, MCP; add openai_strict for strict mode) with JSON paths and fixed definitions, tool pairs models will confuse with fix hints, basic poisoning patterns, a grade and a pin (set_id) for diff_tools. Pass "tools" (array in any common format) or "url" (public remote MCP server; tools are listed, never called). level "lite" returns the summary only. Free: 20 calls/day per IP (shared with diff_tools), then $0.003 lite / $0.01 full via x402 or credits.

[ToolFit via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as ToolFit's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: full $0.01 / lite $0.003 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

level.description: lite = summary only; full (default) = every issue, fixed definitions, pair hints

providers.description: Providers to check (default openai, anthropic, gemini, bedrock, mcp; add openai_strict for Structured Outputs strict mode). GET: comma list.

tier.description: Paid tier: full $0.01, lite $0.003. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

tools.description: Tool definitions: MCP tools/list entries, OpenAI {type:"function",function:{...}}, Anthropic {name,description,input_schema}, Gemini functionDeclarations or Bedrock toolSpec. Max 500.

items.description: A tool definition: name, description and inputSchema (MCP tools/list or OpenAI/Anthropic shape).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the tool input.

url.description: Public remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, https), e.g. https://api.youraitools.co/mcp/hub. ToolFit only lists its tools.
